name: Makeikusa 4
source:
Anderna, a small northern country.
Though lacking in national power, this country has been managed to keep its independence against surrounding powerful countries and the demon army thanks to a presence of one soldier.
Surnamed Katherine the Great Shield, this woman has retired when the great war ended and was enjoying her life with her beloved husband and two sons.
However, the peace broke suddenly; General Aitor, another contributor to the termination of the great war, attempted a rebellion against the royal family with the help from the demon army.
Having learnt the news, she picked up her old ax once again and stepped into the royal castle occupied by monsters...

An original novel game about a sexual disgrace of a female soldier. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE184179.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
安德纳，北方小国。
虽然国力匮乏，但凭借一名士兵的存在，这个国家仍能与周围的强国和魔族军队保持独立。
这位名叫凯瑟琳大盾的女人在大战结束后已经退休，与她深爱的丈夫和两个儿子一起享受生活。
然而，平静突然被打破了。艾托将军是另一位结束大战的功臣，他在恶魔军队的帮助下试图反抗王室。
得知消息的她再次拿起旧斧头，踏入了被怪物占据的王城……

一款关于女兵性耻辱的原创小说游戏。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE184179.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
